description: Integration wiring: connect all Phase 8 modules into the main doot binary, update doot.nimble test task, wire the --prod command to start both dashboard and router, and ensure the full binary compiles cleanly.
steps: Update src/doot/cli.nim - The runProd proc should: (1) determine data directory (use current dir / '.dootd' for portability or check if running as root for /var/lib/dootd), (2) init the dootd database, (3) check if already initialized - if --reset-password flag present, reset and display new password then exit, (4) if not initialized, generate password, display first-run banner (matching the format from docs/dootd.md), attempt systemd registration (catch errors), mark initialized, (5) create ProcessSupervisor, DootdDashboard, HostRouter, (6) start existing apps (load from DB, start child processes, register routes), (7) start dashboard and router (both async, run with asyncdispatch.poll loop or runForever). Handle SIGINT/SIGTERM for graceful shutdown of all children.
Update src/doot.nim - No changes needed (already dispatches via cli.dispatch), but verify the imports compile with the new modules.
Update doot.nimble - Add test_dootd.nim to the test task with correct flags: exec "nim c --threads:on --mm:orc --passL:-largon2 --passL:-lssl --passL:-lcrypto -r tests/test_dootd.nim"
Verify full compilation - Ensure 'nim c src/doot.nim' compiles without errors with all new modules imported through cli.nim.
Run full test suite - Run test_dootd.nim and verify all tests pass. Also run test_cli.nim to ensure existing CLI tests still pass with the new --prod implementation.

Add integration tests to test_dootd.nim - Test the full first-run flow: init state, generate password, verify password works, create an app, validate env vars, verify idempotent re-run. Test the --reset-password flow. Test that the dashboard auth + app CRUD + deploy pipeline work together as a coherent flow.
acceptance_criteria: nim c src/doot.nim compiles without errors
--prod dispatches correctly to the production daemon logic
First-run banner output matches docs/dootd.md format
Integration tests verify the end-to-end flow works
verification: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c src/doot.nim
export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c --threads:on --mm:orc --passL:-largon2 --passL:-lssl --passL:-lcrypto -r tests/test_dootd.nim
export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c -r tests/test_cli.nim
findings: All verification steps pass: nim c src/doot.nim compiles cleanly, test_dootd.nim passes all tests including new integration suites, test_cli.nim passes without regression. The runProd function now starts async servers after initialization. The initDaemonState proc is exported and testable without entering the event loop. First-run banner format updated to match docs/dootd.md. Added --status flag for checking daemon status without starting servers. The tables module needed to be imported in cli.nim for iterating supervisor children during graceful shutdown.
